name: ai-claims-monorepo
description: AI Autonomous Health Insurance Claims Engine with separate Frontend and Backend

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix backend install
scripts.dev: npx --yes concurrently -n "frontend,backend" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.build: npm run build:frontend && npm run build:backend
